resources.string: Keep your keyboard. Add the button Android forgot.
Shows a movable hide-keyboard button while an on-screen keyboard is visible.

KeyDrop uses Android's Accessibility Service to detect when the on-screen keyboard is visible and show the Hide Keyboard button.

Android gives KeyDrop access to information about on-screen windows. KeyDrop checks only whether a keyboard window exists. It does not read or store what you type, inspect screen content, take screenshots, collect data, or share data.

If you agree, Android Accessibility Settings will open. You decide there whether to enable KeyDrop, and you can turn it off at any time.

1. Tap Open Accessibility Settings.
2. Read the KeyDrop disclosure and choose Agree.
3. Select KeyDrop and turn it on.
4. Return here and tap the test field below.

Drag the blue button to save its position. Tap it to dismiss the keyboard.
This device has no Accessibility Settings screen. Open Settings and enable KeyDrop manually.
Private by design: no internet permission, analytics, account, or cloud service. Android grants window access so KeyDrop can detect the keyboard, but KeyDrop never reads or stores typed text.

Effective August 1, 2026

KeyDrop is developed by YakStacks.

ACCESSIBILITY ACCESS
Android grants KeyDrop access to information about on-screen windows. KeyDrop checks only whether a keyboard window exists. It does not traverse accessibility node trees, inspect fields, read or store typed text, take screenshots, or record input.

DATA STORED ON THIS DEVICE
KeyDrop stores the floating button's screen edge, relative vertical position, and whether you accepted the accessibility disclosure. These preferences stay in KeyDrop's private app storage.

COLLECTION AND SHARING
KeyDrop has no internet permission, analytics, advertising, account, cloud service, or runtime third-party software. It does not transmit, sell, or share user or device data.

RETENTION AND DELETION
The local preferences remain until you clear KeyDrop's app storage or uninstall KeyDrop. Either action deletes them.

CONTACT
Privacy questions may be sent to James@yakstacks.com.
